---
name: downstream-strategy-review
description: Product strategy review fixture used to test passive contract subtraction.
---

Read the referenced product sources before questioning the user. Establish the user pain,
status quo, narrowest wedge, and evidence of demand. Force meaningful alternatives.

The decision gates and output obligations in the
[runtime contract](references/runtime-contract.md) are normative. The
[sample scorecard](examples/sample-scorecard.md) is illustrative only and is not part of the
runtime contract.
